figureGroundContrastRule: Mandatory high-contrast figure-ground separation: ivory chalk-stripe and emerald/silver silk couture against dark mahogany and wet granite architecture.
closedLipsOrLipSyncRule: FRAME-ACCURATE NATIVE VOCAL LIP-SYNC (48,000 Hz stereo vocal articulation)
act1VisualRules: Concept: This Zyvoriq production elevates the classic 1930s Art-Deco jazz-funk aesthetic with a razor-sharp 128 BPM, B Minor sonic landscape, featuring a dynamic 60-second narrative arc. We begin in an intimate, chiaroscuro speakeasy, evolving into a vast, rain-slicked city plaza. The styling emphasizes ivory chalk-stripe suits and feathered headpieces, complemented by 6-shot anamorphic cinematography and precise 8-count geometric choreography, ensuring a visually and sonically arresting experience.. Setting & Venue (Act I): USA — Crimson Velvet Speakeasy → Azure Dawn Plaza. Act I: An intimate, dimly lit Art-Deco speakeasy, 'The Crimson Velvet', featuring deep red velvet banquettes, highly polished mahogany bar, walls adorned with geometric brass inlays, and large windows with venetian blinds casting sharp chiaroscuro patterns. A vintage, gleaming jukebox stands prominently. -> Act II: A vast, rain-slicked Art-Deco metropolitan plaza at pre-dawn, 'Azure Dawn Plaza', surrounded by towering skyscrapers with intricate geometric facades in dark granite and polished chrome. The ground is a highly reflective wet pavement, catching the cool blue-grey light of the approaching sunrise. A grand, central stage platform rises from the plaza.. Background & Lighting: Act I: A clandestine Art-Deco speakeasy with mahogany bar, velvet banquettes, heavy venetian blinds casting chiaroscuro shadows, and a vintage coin-operated jukebox. -> Act II: A grand, rain-slicked Art-Deco metropolitan plaza at pre-dawn, with towering, geometrically patterned skyscrapers, reflective wet pavement, and a distant, misty skyline.. Lead Cast: Julian Thorne (Male Lead Actor / Vocalist: Mid 30s, lean facial structure, intense dark eyes, impeccably groomed side-parted hair, sharp jawline, charismatic and slightly mysterious expression.); Elara Vance (Lead Actress / Vocalist: Late 20s, sharp cheekbones, piercing hazel eyes, full lips, smooth olive skin, dark wavy bob with finger waves, confident and enigmatic expression.); Seraphina Dubois (Co-Lead Actress / Vocalist: Early 30s, strong jawline, high cheekbones, luminous dark skin, vibrant feathered headpiece over short curly hair, expressive and observant gaze.); The Syncopated Eight (Each musician (saxophone, trumpet, trombone, upright bass, drums, piano) has a distinctive 1930s-inspired look, holding their respective instruments with focused intensity, dressed in sharp, complementary attire.); The Shadow Dancers (Eight distinct individuals (4 male, 4 female) with synchronized, fluid movements, sharp, angular faces, and focused expressions, maintaining perfect formation without cloning.). Act I Wardrobe: Male Lead in Male Lead: Razor-sharp ivory chalk-stripe double-breasted suit, royal-blue silk pocket square, light blue dress shirt, cream silk tie, with a tilted white fedora.; Female Lead & Co-Lead in Female Lead: Floor-length emerald green silk bias-cut gown with deep V-neck and subtle sequin embellishments, art-deco geometric earrings. Female Co-Lead: Sapphire blue feathered flapper dress with intricate beadwork, matching jeweled headband, and long opera gloves.. Accessories: Male Lead: Two-tone black and white leather spats, ornate signet ring. Female Lead: Art-Deco diamond drop earrings, delicate pearl choker. Female Co-Lead: Feathered headband, long black opera gloves with rhinestone cuffs. All dancers: Custom-designed dance shoes with polished soles for precise footwork.. Music & Vocals: 128 BPM Art-Deco Speakeasy Jazz-Funk, Syncopated Slap-Bass & Brass Groove (B Minor), Rich, resonant baritone for Male Lead with a slight reverb; sultry, expressive mezzo-soprano for Female Lead with a smoky quality; bright, clear soprano for Female Co-Lead. All voices are 48kHz studio quality, perfectly synchronized with the 128 BPM B Minor jazz-funk instrumental, featuring tight harmonies and call-and-response dynamics., sung in English. Choreography & Emotions: Act I: Intricate solo footwork and partner work with sharp, geometric lines, incorporating a coin-toss jukebox ignition. -> Act II: Expansive, synchronized ensemble formations, including an 8-dancer V-wedge lock-step, reverse-glide footwork, and the iconic 45-degree anti-gravity forward lean illusion on the wet plaza.. Act I: Intrigue, playful challenge, confident swagger, subtle flirtation with focused eye contact and knowing smiles. -> Act II: Determined resolve, exhilaration, synchronized power, and a sense of collective triumph with expansive, upward gazes..
